props.tex: \begin{aligned}\mathbf x_1^\top\mathbf x_2&=3\cdot6+2\cdot4+0\cdot0=18+8+0=26\\\lVert\mathbf x_1\rVert^2&=3^2+2^2+0^2=9+4+0=13\\\lVert\mathbf x_2\rVert^2&=6^2+4^2+0^2=36+16+0=52\\\frac{\mathbf x_1^\top\mathbf x_2}{\lVert\mathbf x_1\rVert\,\lVert\mathbf x_2\rVert}&=\frac{26}{\sqrt{13}\,\sqrt{52}}=\frac{26}{\sqrt{676}}=\frac{26}{26}=1\\\mathbf x_1^\top\mathbf x_3&=3\cdot0+2\cdot1+0\cdot3=0+2+0=2\\\lVert\mathbf x_3\rVert^2&=0^2+1^2+3^2=0+1+9=10\\\frac{\mathbf x_1^\top\mathbf x_3}{\lVert\mathbf x_1\rVert\,\lVert\mathbf x_3\rVert}&=\frac{2}{\sqrt{13}\,\sqrt{10}}=\frac2{\sqrt{130}}\end{aligned}
